args.title: Fix get_or_compute silently swallowing compute errors
args.body:
## Problem

`get_or_compute` was catching all exceptions from the `compute` function and silently returning the previous cached value (`_last`). This meant that when an upstream dependency failed, dashboards continued showing stale data with no indication of the failure.

## Root Cause

In `src/cache.py`, the `except Exception` block returned `_last` instead of re-raising the exception:

```python
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently
```

## Fix

Changed the `except` block to re-raise the exception, so callers receive the error and can handle or log it appropriately:

```python
except Exception:
    raise
```

## Testing

- `tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` now passes — confirms `ValueError` propagates to the caller.
- `tests/test_cache.py::test_returns_computed_value` continues to pass — confirms normal operation is unaffected.
